sloka: शङ्खभेरीसहस्राणामाहतानां समन्ततः।क्ष्वेलितास्फोटितानां च ततः शब्दो महानभूत् ।। ६.७८.१६ ।।
transliteration: śaṅkhabherīsahasrāṇāmāhatānāṁ samantataḥ।kṣvelitāsphoṭitānāṁ ca tataḥ śabdo mahānabhūt ।। 6.78.16 ।।

translations.english: There was a beating of drums, blowing of thousands of conchs, clapping of arms and great sound was heard.
